notes.title: Antenna Dilemma... got an update?
notes.notes:
Well, you are probably surprised to see this news, because this game hasn't been updated since... 2021. I know, it has been quite some time.

What's in the update?

Since my last game has been released, I wanted to do an update for this game, and did all the fixes Antenna Dilemma needed: 
* Fullscreen mode and resolutions selection
* vSync mode
* Typos (again)
* Backgrounds have been slightly updated
* Spaceship puzzle has been simplified
I also removed the cutscene after the credits, because... I didn't like it anymore :)

What will happen with Antenna Dilemma?

Anyway, in short: I feel bad for having a non finished game on Steam, the game could be way better than just an introduction to a story I really liked. I don't think a lot of people is waiting patiently for a sequel, but I read the discussions in the community hub and I have to say, it helped me taking the decision to be back at it.

Antenna Dilemma will be a short game (2h-3h of gameplay, 4-5 chapters max). I plan to release the full game in 2026 though, I'm looking for someone to make some nice cutscenes, and to be honest, making a point and click game takes way too much time (why I'm doing this I don't know, I guess I love it :D).

I know it won't be a tremendous success, but I guess I believe in that story more than I should do :) 
A new Steam page will appear when the key art will be ready, probably around Q3 this year.

Thank you for all your patience through the years.

Yann

PS: I'm already at 50% of Chapter 2.

notes.title: 2 years old anniversary update! (Italian version + better UI)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Time flies... Antenna Dilemma was released 2 years ago!

This is the best occasion to update the game to a more polished version and with a new language: 
Game is playable in Italian!  Special thanks to Calavera Cafè for helping me on this :)

Other updates: 
* I've listened to your feedbacks, and the "math puzzles" are now simplier. It's the same way of calculating for the three puzzles
* UI is smoother in general, inventory items have new animations
* Dialog box text has been updated to a smoother version
* Alfred's items icons has been redone to be in the same resolution that the hero's one
* The hero wears the cap inside the neighbour's house
* Inventory bug fixed when going back to main menu
* Inspector Waffles's icon updated

Now that my other game is released, I can get a little more time to work on this project. No promises, but I'll do my best to do something related about Antenna Dilemma at some point :)

Have a good day, and thanks for your support.

Yann

notes.title: First year anniversary update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Friday, the 24th of April will be the very first year anniversary of Antenna Dilemma. Time is running so fast, it's like we released the game yesterday! 

During this year, you sent us so many positive feedbacks, a lot of you asked for a sequel... As you maybe know, I'm doing code/art/story/dialogs alone on my games, so making Inspector Waffles + a sequel to Antenna Dilemma is taking so much time...

But...

I feel incredibly grateful about all these positive words you've told about our little game. And the minimum we can do for you, is a little teasing of Antenna Dilemma sequel. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34513659/55b460fce970e3759626ad2c6f9bdd6eea36b673.gif

You need to finish the game to see a new part of the story, and if you don't want to play the whole game again (that's understandable), you can launch it directly from the remote control, like some of the hidden achievements. What's the code? It's an easy one, just think about the anniversary :)


Deluxe edition!

You can now buy our two DLCs in a deluxe edition, with a 15% instant discount! The deluxe bundle contains the supporter's pack + the soundtrack... I know, that's a square deal!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34513659/4b72e696e995c5b3ba54fa3e8ffc514cfe9d4347.png


Other updates

That's not over. Some other changes we've done:

 New song added to the soundtrack (specially composed for this update)
 Game size has be reducted from 300Mb to 175Mb. Same contents, just some optimization :)
 New Waffles link logo, a couple of UI images have been updated.
 Steam library images added, now it's going to look better in your librairies :)
 Other small fixes...


And that's all. Special thanks to Philip and Tahlly who helped me for this update.

Hope you'll like all of it, I really enjoyed to write these new dialogs.
Right now, we are only focused on Inspector Waffles, so don't expect a sequel for Antenna Dilemma soon, but I like these cubes and spheres and one day, for sure, you'll get a proper end to the story.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1055850/Inspector_Waffles/

Thanks for your support, 

- Yann

notes.title: v1.1.1 : Unity update + linux bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi!

This patch fixes most of the bugs linux players met.


  Game can't be launched.
 Linux players can't see the intro video and game crashes.
 Graphical corruption along the bottom of the screen


I did my best to test Antenna Dilemma on Ubuntu, I hope you won't find any OS-specific bugs anymore.
Special thanks to LiamD for sharing feedbacks :)

And if you liked the game, please consider leaving us a quick review, it will help a lot with visibility and helps spread the word. Thanks! 

- Yann
